name: Nakoa-Wolf Momoa
bio: Nakoa-Wolf Manakauapo Namakaeha Momoa (born December 15, 2008) is an American actor who will make his feature-film acting debut in Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three (2026). He is the son of actor Jason Momoa and actress Lisa Bonet.

credits.title: Dune: Part Three
credits.overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow.
